subject_line: Generative AI Engineer Application - Ayushkumar Burde
body:
I am applying for the Generative AI Engineer position. I have built production-grade RAG pipelines using LangChain and vector databases like FAISS, alongside FastAPI services for LLM integration.

My recent work includes a Generative AI resume builder featuring JWT authentication and vector similarity search. I have experience developing chatbots and automation tools using Python and REST APIs.

Please review the attached resume. I am available for a brief call to discuss my technical background.
